name: core-engine
description: Core Engine - Core Engine: plataforma de comercio electronico distribuido (microservicios NestJS + Supabase + Docker)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @core/api-gateway && npm run build -w @core/identity-service && npm run build -w @core/catalog-service && npm run build -w @core/stores-service && npm run build -w @core/orders-service && npm run build -w @core/logistics-service && npm run build -w @core/commissions-service && npm run build -w @core/finance-service && npm run build -w @core/field-service && npm run build -w @core/market-intelligence-service && npm run build -w @core/storage-service
scripts.test: npm run test -w @core/shared -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/api-gateway -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/orders-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/commissions-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/finance-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/market-intelligence-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/catalog-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/identity-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/stores-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/logistics-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/field-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/storage-service -- --coverage
scripts.swagger:export: npm run build && npm run swagger:export --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/cli.mjs swagger && npm run build -w @core/api-gateway
